summary.text: Herb Olson is a Democrat who has represented Addison-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2025.
He sits on the House Committee on Commerce and Economic Development.

paragraphs.text: Olson was born in 1951 in Mineola, on Long Island, and his family later moved to Toronto, according to his House biography.
He completed secondary school in Massachusetts, attended Middlebury College, and received a law degree from Northwestern School of Law in Portland, Oregon, in 1976.
Professionally he worked at Vermont Legal Aid, as an Assistant Attorney General for the Departments of Mental Health and of Corrections, and as a Legislative Counsel staff attorney.
He was also General Counsel for the Vermont Department of Banking, Insurance, Securities and Health Care Administration and worked for the Rhode Island Office of the Health Insurance Commissioner.
His civic memberships include the Mt. Abe High School Board, the Starksboro Planning Commission and the Addison County Regional Planning Commission.
